He chased the old rooster and raced with the hen. He jumped over fences again and again. But late in the evening when stars filled the sky.. He thought of a human named Anh with a sigh,
“I wonder,” he oinked, “if he’ll come here someday.. To play in the fields and to laugh and to stay! I’ve never met Anh but I’ve dreamed of his face? Of kindness and smiles in this quiet old place”
Then one sunny morning the gate opened wide. And Anh walked right in with a soft gentle stride. The pig stopped his rolling and stared in surprise! Then trotted right over with bright happy eyes.
Anh knelt in the grass and he scratched behind the pigs ears. He whispered soft words that the pig loved to hear. They ran through the orchard and under the trees. They splashed in the creek with the cool summer breeze. They played hide-and-seek near the old wooden barn. They raced past the horses and out to the corn. Ahn taught him a dance, that went left then went right. They twirled until sunset turned day into night. The pig brought him apples he’d found on the ground. They shared them together without making a sound. Then Anh brushed his coat till it shone soft and pink. And sat by his side near the water to drink. When stars filled the sky and the moon climbed up high.. The pig curled beside him and let out a sigh, “I dreamed of you Anh,” he oinked soft in the dark, “And now that I’ve met you my heart has a spark”
From that day forward, whenever Anh came. The pig ran to meet him and called out his name. They played every season through sunshine and rain. And the farm felt much happier time and again..

No, I don't think so, he has so many underrated songs! His birthday is on 31st of July, it's actually for the release date, his real birthday is on April 1st. Most people only know of him because of GakuGumi and GakuKai, so sad! Did you know Gakupo Kamui's voice producer is Gackt? Gackt's really famous, mainly for his music and vocals, he was the lead vocalist and song writer for Malice Mizer from 1995 to 1999, and his stage name is Kamui Gakuto. But he kinda throws me off a bit, I don't know why! Gakupo is better! Did you know Gakupo's katana isn't a solid boring colour of gray? It's actually kinda colourful—it has patterns and makes musical sounds when he swings it around, so cool! It also has a name, Gakutou Miburi. He also has a fan, and it has a character for "music" written onto it. His character is designed by Kentaro Miura, whoever that is! I don't really care a lot to be honest! Eggplant is his representative symbol. Gakupo also goes by a few other names, Gackpoid, Gackpo, Camui Gackpo... So awesome, he goes by other nicknames from fans too! He used to be included with the cryptonloid group, and so did Gumi. He's been updated around 3-4 times, for voicebanks, and a couple other that aren't really important to mention. One more fact to add, apparently there is a sub-species centered around him; "Kamui Gakuko," a female version, yes! However she is known as a fan-loid and pitch-loid. I have written all of this in one sitting, so now I must compliment him for finality. Very cute, yes! I love the makeup he wears, his nails too, it really contradicts his male attire as a samurai! I hope to buy more merch of you in the future, and your nendoroid too! You are purple too, it is my favourite colour! Sooo cute, you very much are, Gakupo! My dear Arthur,
You never showed up, and now, after looking at the newspapers I understand why. I don't imagine you will receive this letter but I nonetheless must send it. Arthur, oh, Arthur. I was just starting to dream the silliest and softest of dreams. I miss you, and I will always miss you but I cannot live like that, and it seems you cannot live any other way.
When I'm with you, the world makes sense; but when we are apart, I see clearly that your world is not a world from which one can escape. I'm so sorry, for everything, for everything long ago and for starting up that business again. There's a good man within you, Arthur, but he is wrestling with a giant. And the giant... wins, time and again. You've broken my heart, again, and I fear I have broken yours.
For that, I will never forgive myself but you must let me go now. I enclose a ring you gave me many years ago, when we were both young, not because I don't like it, but because I care for it far too much and it reminds me too much of you. I hope, one day... you will find some people in love who can use this, for it kept me thinking of you all these years, and I hope by returning it to you I can finally be free.
Goodbye
Mary
